faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth Rahuri (MPKV) for various research and technical positions under the AI3C project located in Rahuri, Maharashtra.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available under MPKV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 vacancies available across multiple specialist posts including AI/ML and Data Science Lead, Geospatial and Remote Sensing Specialist, Robotics Specialist, and Project Associates.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the offline application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the filled offline application form is 19 October 2026 up to 6:00 PM. Candidates must ensure timely submission by post or in person.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for MPKV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The mode of application is strictly offline. Interested candidates must send their filled application forms in the prescribed proforma to the designated nodal officer by post or in person.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for the AI/ML and Data Science Lead post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the AI/ML and Data Science Lead position is 50 years, with provisions for relaxation in exceptional cases as per university norms.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Junior Technical Fellow / Project Associates?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Junior Technical Fellow / Project Associates position will receive a consolidated salary of up to Rs. 70,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. What educational qualification is required for the Geospatial Specialist?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post-Graduation or Post Graduate Diploma in Geoinformatics, Remote Sensing, GIS, or a related domain along with the required total experience.

faq.question: Q8. Where should the completed application form be sent?
faq.answer: The application should be sent to the Nodal Officer, Artificial Intelligence Innovation and Incubation Center (AI3C), Department of Agril. Engineering, Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth, Rahuri, Dist: Ahilyanagar - 413722 (MS).

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for applying to MPKV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for any of the advertised contractual positions under this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for these contractual posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves the initial shortlisting of eligible candidates followed by a personal interview conducted by the selection committee at MPKV.
